# Provenance fixtures

Original 2x2 test squares created for this repository on 2026-11-21, dedicated to
CC0-1.0. No downloaded artwork or private production certificates. Generated by
`generate_fixtures.py` using Pillow, Python cryptography and official
[c2patool 0.29.0](https://github.com/contentauth/c2patool/releases/tag/v0.29.0)
(MIT/Apache-2.0). The generator is the exact recipe. Run it with the tool's absolute
path; it generates fresh random certificates/signatures, so the new bytes differ.

| File | How made | Default runtime expectation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| plain.png | PNG signature + IHDR, zlib IDAT, IEND with CRC32 | No credentials found |
| stable-diffusion.png | Adds tEXt `parameters`, test prompt, steps/sampler/seed | No credentials found + unsigned SD hint |
| compressed-metadata.png | Adds zTXt Software=ComfyUI and compressed iTXt prompt JSON | No credentials found + unsigned hints |
| stripped.jpg | Pillow JPEG encoder, no EXIF/XMP, 2x2 solid color | No credentials found |
| large-stripped.jpg | Original deterministic 128x128 RGB pattern, Pillow JPEG quality 90, no EXIF; 13,242 bytes | No credentials found after authoritative SDK read |
| signed.png | c2patool, ES256 leaf under disposable root A, four actions, created AI source type | Unknown signer |
| untrusted.png | Independently signed with disposable root B | Unknown signer |
| corrupted-signature.png | Change first `ProvenanceFixture` P to Q inside signed claim; repair containing caBX CRC | Signature invalid |
| truncated.png | 17 bytes: PNG header + absurd caBX length + one byte | Signature invalid (SDK parsing error) |
| binding-mismatch.png | Adds legal Comment tEXt before IEND after signing | Signature invalid (data hash mismatch) |

`mutation.json` records the exact zero-based byte offset and CRC adjustment.
Corruption changes the signed claim rather than the pixels. Signing uses generated
test leaf/root certificates valid 2026-01-01 through 2036-01-01 with critical key
usage/basic constraints and emailProtection EKU. No timestamp authority is called.
Private keys exist only in a deleted temporary directory. `test-root-A.crt` is
public test material, never installed in the runtime trust list. A positive
automated verification test explicitly injects root A: signed.png then verifies;
untrusted.png remains unknown. The UI never trusts either test signer by default.
The fixture was signed by software but declares AI generation deliberately: a
valid credential is a signed declaration, not proof that its statement is true.

Each file has `*.expected.json` for parser/status/declaration expectations.
`*.c2patool-{untrusted,test-trusted}.json` are actual offline CLI outputs, not
fabricated validation results. `*.sdk-{untrusted,test-trusted}.json` record actual
vendored WASM reports for the original signed variants. Automated tests rerun real
WASM and compare state and validation code sets with the CLI for all four signed
variants. CLI embeds c2pa-rs 0.92.0; the tested validation code sets agree with
the pinned WASM implementation. Refresh records and mutation offsets whenever
regenerating; expired test certificates should fail validation in the future.

The large JPEG is made by large_stripped_jpeg() in the generator. Pixel channel c
at (x,y) is (17*x + 31*y + x*y + 53*c) mod 256. The marker walk exhausts its cheap
scan budget, so it must use the SDK. This catches the browser SDK's null-reader
absence result that the original small JPEG fixture did not exercise. Its recipe
can be invoked independently without regenerating the random signing certificates.
